entities.summary: Jordan Grayson Mickey is an American professional basketball player for Qingdao Eagles of the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA). He played college basketball for the LSU Tigers before being selected by the Boston Celtics with the 33rd overall pick in the 2015 NBA draft.
